title: The Free bird over the field
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：free　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 free 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the warden wrote of ① a free bird over the field in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② freer than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the free ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the freest bird over the field anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too free to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the free ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a free meal for the children, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as free as the meal for the children they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was free or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something free, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite free; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the free ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, on the same day, she wrote of another free bird over the field in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ freer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The freest meal for the children in the whole centre, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the free ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自由（前置定语 a free bird over the field：1956 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件自由的飞鸟）
B. adj. 自由／免费（比较级 freer than：文中两处，一处比田野上空的飞鸟，一处比预想）
C. adj. 自由／免费（最高级 the freest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自由（表语 too free to do：母亲觉得它太自由，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 免费（前置定语 a free meal for the children：叔叔把整件事称作一桩免费的餐）
F. adj. 免费（同级比较 as free as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩孩子们的免费餐相比）
G. adj. 免费（后置定语 something free：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 免费（受程度副词修饰 quite free：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a free bird over the field
the freest bird over the field anybody
a free meal for the children
The freest meal for the children in

answers.why: free 意为“自由”，1956 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件自由的飞鸟”，此处作前置定语 a free bird over the field。
free 意为“自由”，此处用比较级 freer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
free 意为“自由”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最自由的一件，故用最高级 the freest bird over the field。
free 意为“自由”，母亲认为这件东西“太自由了，谁也用不上”，too free to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
free 意为“免费”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩免费的餐”，此处作前置定语 a free meal for the children。
free 意为“免费”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩孩子们的免费餐一样免费”，同级比较用 as free as。
free 意为“免费”，登记册上那半行字要的是“免费的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something free。
free 意为“免费”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当免费”，quite 修饰原级 free。
free 意为“免费”，1966 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要免费”，故用比较级 freer than。
free 意为“免费”，母亲 1968 年说的是“整个社区中心里最免费的那一桩”，故用最高级 the freest meal for the children。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件自由的飞鸟。（a free bird over the field）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更自由。（freer than …）
母亲觉得它太自由，谁也用不上。（too free to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩免费的餐。（a free meal for the children）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩孩子们的免费餐一样免费。（as free as …）
到了 1963 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件免费的东西。（something free）
answers: In 1956 the warden wrote of a free bird over the field in the register.
Everybody said it was freer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too free to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a free meal for the children.
He said nobody would call it as free as the meal for the children they had once had.
By 1963 the register asked for nothing but something free.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 free 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the warden wrote of a free bird over the field in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the freest bird over the field in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too free to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a free meal for the children, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite free, and everybody laughed.
The free ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
